Overview

Alicante is a city in Valencian Community with a population of 338,000. A vibrant Mediterranean port city with a stunning castle, palm-lined esplanade, and beautiful sandy beaches. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 10b growing zone supports Hot — tropical and subtropical crops, year-round growing. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 290 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
